papers.title: MouseGPT: A Large-scale Vision-Language Model for Mouse Behavior Analysis
papers.abstract: Analyzing animal behavior is crucial in neuroscience, yet deciphering its intricate dynamics remains challenging. Traditional machine vision approaches detect spontaneous behaviors but are constrained by limited interpretability and reliance on manual labeling, restricting exploration of the full behavioral spectrum. Here, we introduce MouseGPT, an integrated vision-language model and analytical framework that translates raw video of animal activity into natural language to automate open-vocabulary behavior analysis. Built upon a comprehensive dataset of over 42 million frames spanning diverse psychiatric conditions, MouseGPT maps multi-view or single-camera recordings directly into computable semantic representations. An agentic framework leverages these representations for detailed behavior profiling, cross-view stable clustering, and zero-shot novel behavior discovery without requiring labor-intensive annotation. Surpassing conventional kinematics-based pipelines and generalist vision-language models in behavioral precision and adaptability, MouseGPT establishes continuous semantic representations as a powerful tool for deciphering complex ethological dynamics in animal models.

summary.takeaway: 提出 MouseGPT，一个视觉-语言模型与分析框架，将动物活动视频转为自然语言，实现开放词汇的行为分析。
summary.methods: 基于超过 4200 万帧、覆盖多种精神疾病状态的数据集构建；将多视角或单摄像头记录映射为可计算语义表示，并用智能体框架进行行为画像、跨视角稳定聚类和零样本新行为发现。
summary.relevance: 与多模态学习、跨模态理解与生成相关，将视频行为数据与语言语义对齐，面向开放词汇分析。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告其优于传统运动学流程和通用视觉-语言模型，但未给出具体指标和消融实验数值。

papers.title: VIOLIN: A modular framework for scalable reconciliation of heterogeneous interaction graphs
papers.abstract: Automated extraction of molecular interactions from scientific literature has outpaced the development of systematic methods for integrating this information with curated models and knowledge graphs. Here we present VIOLIN (Versatile Interaction Organizing to Leverage Information in Networks), a configurable, attribute-aware reconciliation framework that formally compares newly extracted interaction lists against structured baseline graphs. VIOLIN classifies each interaction as a corroboration, contradiction, flagged case, or extension, and supports configurable attribute inclusion strategies and mismatch semantics to adjust reconciliation strictness. We evaluate VIOLIN using interaction lists generated by two traditional NLP systems (REACH, INDRA) and two large language models (GPT-4.1, Llama 3) across multiple literature corpora and structurally distinct baseline graphs. Across all conditions, reconciliation outcomes were stable and interpretable, with extensions dominating and corroboration-contradiction balance reflecting intrinsic structural relationships between baseline graphs and extracted evidence. Sensitivity analyses demonstrate that attribute inclusion and classification scheme selection shift category boundaries predictably. Benchmark evaluations confirm high algorithmic correctness and alignment with expert curation. VIOLIN is publicly available as a Python package and through web-based interface (https://nmzlab.github.io/Tools-UI).

summary.takeaway: 提出 VIOLIN，一个可配置、属性感知的调和框架，将文献抽取的相互作用列表与基线图结构化比较并分类。
summary.methods: 将新抽取的相互作用与结构化基线图比较，分类为佐证、矛盾、标记案例或扩展；用 REACH、INDRA、GPT-4.1、Llama 3 在多个文献语料和结构不同的基线上评估，并进行敏感性与基准分析。
summary.relevance: 涉及大语言模型抽取结果与知识图谱的对齐和调和，属于检索增强与对齐、知识图谱整合方向。
summary.caveat: 摘要强调结果稳定可解释并与专家标注对齐，但未提供具体精确率或召回率数值；分类边界受属性纳入和方案选择影响。

papers.title: scHGNN: A single-cell gene regulatory network inference method based on heuristic graph neural networks.
papers.abstract: The construction of gene regulatory networks based on single-cell transcriptomics (scRNA-seq) data provides crucial technical support for decoding cell fate determination mechanisms at the single-cell level, elucidating molecular mechanisms underlying disease progression, and developing targeted therapeutics. Existing methods for constructing GRNs often rely excessively on gene expression features, struggling to achieve an effective balance between local direct regulatory signals and global multi-step regulatory pathways. This imbalance results in insufficient utilization of topological information within the network structure. Therefore, this study proposes a heuristic graph neural network-based GRN inference model (scHGNN). scHGNN integrates multi-order neighbor topological information into learnable weights through unified heuristic matrix and link prediction modules, thereby balancing local and global regulatory relationships. This approach effectively fuses gene expression features with network structural information to achieve precise inference of latent regulatory links within gene regulatory networks. Across GRN inference tasks using benchmark networks of varying gene scales and diverse origins, scHGNN consistently outperforms existing mainstream methods on key evaluation metrics. Furthermore, in target gene prediction cases for key transcription factors such as TP53, OTX2, and FOXP1, the model achieved validation rates as high as 76%-84% in the hTFtarget database. This not only supports its accuracy in identifying known regulatory relationships but also indicates its potential to identify high-confidence candidate regulatory interactions for further biological investigation. Collectively, these results demonstrate that scHGNN holds significant application value in elucidating gene regulatory mechanisms and exploring the molecular basis of related diseases.

summary.takeaway: 提出 scHGNN，用启发式图神经网络在单细胞转录组数据中推断基因调控网络，平衡局部直接调控与全局多步通路信息。
summary.methods: 通过统一启发式矩阵和链接预测模块将多阶邻居拓扑信息融入可学习权重，融合基因表达特征与网络结构；在多个不同规模和来源的基准网络上评测，并做 TP53、OTX2、FOXP1 等转录因子的靶基因预测验证。
summary.relevance: 直接面向 GRN/Regulon 推断与图谱构建表示，属于基因调控网络推理方法。
summary.caveat: 摘要称在关键指标上持续优于主流方法，但未给出具体对比数值；数据库验证率不代表因果调控关系。

papers.title: Automated Knowledge Graph Construction for CAR T Cell Receptor Design via Hybrid Text Mining
papers.abstract: Designing next-generation Chimeric Antigen Receptors (CARs) requires a systematic understanding of intracellular signaling domains and their downstream biological effects, yet no comprehensive knowledge resource currently exists for this purpose. Here, we present an automated workflow that integrates multiple natural language processing and large language model tools to extract biomolecular interactions from PubMed literature and assemble them into a CAR T cell signaling knowledge graph. Our pipeline combines REACH, INDRA, and Llama 3 across 15 targeted search queries, yielding a directed multi-relational graph of ~7,500 unique interactions among ~1,800 entities, including proteins, biological processes, and chemicals. We further demonstrate that queries incorporating biological process ontology terms retrieve more interaction-rich papers than protein-name-only searches, offering practical guidance for future literature mining efforts. The resulting knowledge base provides a structured foundation for predicting T cell phenotypes and prioritizing intracellular domain candidates for CAR design, with broader applicability to knowledge-driven inference in immunotherapy research.

summary.takeaway: 构建自动化流程，从 PubMed 文献提取生物分子相互作用并组装 CAR T 细胞信号知识图谱，为 CAR 胞内域设计提供结构化资源。
summary.methods: 结合 REACH、INDRA 和 Llama 3，在 15 个定向检索查询上抽取，形成约 7500 条唯一相互作用、约 1800 个实体的有向多关系图；比较含生物过程本体词的查询与仅蛋白名查询的检索效果。
summary.relevance: 涉及大语言模型辅助知识抽取与知识图谱构建，面向免疫治疗知识驱动推理。
summary.caveat: 摘要未报告抽取准确率等定量评价；知识图谱目前是候选基础，尚需实验验证其在表型预测中的效用。

papers.title: Multi-Angle Lateral-View Breast Tissue Classification in Thermographic Images Using Deep Reinforcement Learning and Statistical Shape Modelling
papers.abstract: This study is a multi-stage method for accurately segmenting and classifying breast tissue in thermographic images, with a specific focus on lateral views captured at multiple angles (30{degrees}, 45{degrees}, and 90{degrees}). Our algorithm is a hybrid boundary detection framework that combines scanning, tracking, and a deep reinforcement learning (DRL) algorithm to delineate the external breast tissue boundary precisely. The DRL agent corrects inaccurately detected landmark points and reduces the average localization error to 17.4 pixels. A Statistical Shape Model (SSM) captures shape variability and refines landmark alignment. A geometric arc-based method estimates the posterior breast boundary, which facilitates robust breast tissue isolation across various lateral view angles. After that, we pull texture features using GLCM (Grey Level Co-occurrence Matrix) and feed them through an SVM classifier. The proposed pipeline boosted diagnostic performance - the SVM hit 74.1% accuracy on our segmented images. It is about 15% better than raw originals and 21% above cropped images. The results prove the effectiveness of our multi-angle lateral view analysis combined with reinforcement learning and statistical shape modelling in enhancing breast cancer detection from thermographic imaging.

summary.takeaway: 提出多阶段方法，在 30、45、90 度侧位热成像中分割并分类乳腺组织，结合深度强化学习与统计形状模型。
summary.methods: 用扫描、跟踪和 DRL 混合边界检测，DRL 修正地标点并将平均定位误差降至 17.4 像素；统计形状模型精化地标对齐，几何弧方法估计后边界；GLCM 提取纹理特征后由 SVM 分类。
summary.relevance: 涉及强化学习在医学图像分析中的应用，与匹配主题中的强化学习相关。
summary.caveat: 仅报告在自建分割图像上 SVM 达 74.1% 准确率，样本与外部验证信息不足；摘要未说明数据集规模和统计显著性。

papers.title: Direction-aware graph attention modeling and co-expression integration reveal novel core regulators of shared drought and salinity stress responses in rice leaves.
papers.abstract: Although differential expression analysis has identified numerous drought- and salinity-responsive genes in rice, it cannot resolve the directional, transcription factor (TF)-driven regulatory architecture underlying responses across independent drought and salinity datasets. To address this, we applied TF-Anchored Directed SiGaResNet, a signed, direction-aware graph attention residual network with a TF-anchored edge-retention rule and permutation-based validation, to RNA-seq profiles from 92 rice leaf samples (51 stress, 41 control) derived from independent drought and salinity studies. Unlike conventional correlation- or co-expression-based approaches, the framework constrains regulatory inference around TF nodes while learning directed, signed relationships through supervised graph representation learning. Differential expression analysis identified 719 genes (405 upregulated, 314 downregulated), with induced transcripts enriched in stress-response and hormone-signaling processes and repressed transcripts dominated by photosynthesis- and secondary-metabolism-related processes. The framework showed strong cross-validated classification performance (MCC = 0.78 ± 0.17; AUC = 0.95 ± 0.05). The resulting directed gene regulatory network comprised 137 nodes and 163 edges and exhibited a sparse, modular architecture (modularity = 0.77; 15 communities), with TFs significantly enriched among regulatory source nodes (P < 0.001). Hub regulators were distributed across multiple TF families, predominantly bZIP, MYB-related, and NAC. Eighteen of thirty-two prioritized TF-encoding genes were independently corroborated within stress-associated WGCNA modules, and four comparatively uncharacterized candidates (Os07g0176200, Os05g0569300, Os03g0231000, and Os02g0187700) received convergent computational support from promoter cis-element enrichment, protein functional-association topology, and leave-one-out cross-validation classification. Quantitative real-time PCR further confirmed stress-responsive expression of all four candidates under separate drought and salinity treatments, supporting their prioritization as putative candidate regulators. These findings indicate that direction- and sign-aware graph attention modeling can integrate transcriptomic information from independent drought and salinity studies to identify biologically coherent, TF-centered regulatory patterns and prioritize candidate regulators for further functional investigation, without establishing causal regulatory mechanisms.
papers.venue: Plant science : an international journal of experimental plant biology

summary.takeaway: 应用方向感知的图注意力模型整合独立干旱和盐胁迫 RNA-seq 数据，推断以转录因子为中心的有向调控网络并优先候选调控基因。
summary.methods: 使用 TF-Anchored Directed SiGaResNet，带符号、方向感知的图注意力残差网络，配合 TF 锚定边保留规则和置换验证；分析 92 个水稻叶片样本（51 胁迫、41 对照）；结合差异表达、WGCNA 和 qRT-PCR 验证候选基因。
summary.relevance: 直接对应 GRN/Regulon、图谱构建与表示学习，强调有向有符号调控推断。
summary.caveat: 摘要明确不建立因果调控机制；网络来自计算推断，候选基因仅经计算与表达验证，功能尚未实验确证。

papers.title: Root gene regulatory network analysis reveals roles for defense hormones and secondary metabolites in establishment of disease-suppressive soil
papers.abstract: Plants recruit beneficial microbiota in their rhizosphere to alleviate stresses. In Arabidopsis thaliana, foliar infection by Hyaloperonospora arabidopsidis (Hpa) has been shown to establish a disease-suppressive microbiome that promotes protection against Hpa infection of the subsequent plant generation grown in this conditioned soil - a phenomenon known as soil-borne legacy (SBL). The root responses involved in SBL establishment have remained largely unclear. In this study, time-series RNA-seq of roots from Hpa-infected plants grown in natural soil was conducted over seven days post-inoculation. A gene regulatory network of the responding roots was constructed. The role of predicted key components was verified in follow-up assays. Root transcriptional reprogramming started within one day after foliar infection. Genes associated with salicylic acid (SA)-mediated defense were upregulated, while those linked to secondary metabolism and jasmonic acid (JA) responsiveness were downregulated. SA accumulation increased at 1 dpi, and JA decreased by 3 dpi. Transcriptional regulation occurred primarily in the tips of the roots. Mutant analyses confirmed that SA, JA, indole glucosinolates, camalexin, and flavonoids contribute to SBL establishment. Our findings reveal rapid systemic transcriptional reprogramming in roots upon foliar pathogen attack, uncovering novel roles of hormone signaling and secondary metabolism in shaping a disease-suppressive soil beyond their known defense functions.

summary.takeaway: 通过根部时间序列转录组和基因调控网络分析，揭示防御激素与次生代谢在拟南芥建立抑病土壤中的作用。
summary.methods: 对叶部感染 Hpa 的植株在自然土壤中取根，做接种后 7 天时间序列 RNA-seq，构建响应根基因调控网络；用突变体分析验证 SA、JA、吲哚硫苷、camalexin 和类黄酮的作用。
summary.relevance: 属于 GRN/Regulon 研究，用调控网络解析植物-微生物互作中的根系响应。
summary.caveat: 机制结论主要基于拟南芥突变体和关联分析；摘要未说明网络推断的具体算法与统计细节。

papers.title: Quantitative evidence for foraging preferences of shrill carder bumble bee (Bombus sylvarum) queens
papers.abstract: Introduction Bumblebees are facing declines globally due to agricultural intensification and climate change. In the UK, the shrill-carder bumble bee, Bombus sylvarum, has dramatically declined and is now restricted to five isolated populations across England and Wales. A key life-cycle stage for bumblebees is the spring queen, who is responsible for colony establishment, but we lack quantitative data to inform conservation practice for this life stage. Aim/methods To quantify foraging preferences and floral resource dependency of spring queens in B. sylvarum. We determined the floral resources preferred by B. sylvarum queens across their activity period, along with the potential for inter-specific resource competition. Results At the start of the season, B. sylvarum queens foraged solely on Lamium album and Trifolium repens. Later they increased their foraging breadth but predominantly foraged on Vicia villosa and Rhinanthus minor. Plant-pollinator networks indicate the potential for competition with more common bumble bee species, with B. sylvarum queens exhibiting a broader foraging range than these potential competitors. Discussion As the season progresses, the foraging diversity of B. sylvarum queens increases. Later in the season, the lower species specificity index for B. sylvarum queens suggests that these queens are less specialised than their congeneric competitors. Implications for insect conservation: Our results show that early in the season B. sylvarum queens rely on two floral species. Managing sites to maintain and increase strong populations of these plant species will likely enhance queen success, which is crucial to enable colony establishment and population growth.

summary.takeaway: 量化英国稀有的 Bombus sylvarum 春季蜂王的觅食偏好和植物-传粉者网络，为保护提供依据。
summary.methods: 在其活动期调查蜂王偏好的花卉资源，并构建植物-传粉者网络评估与常见熊蜂的种间资源竞争潜力。
summary.relevance: 与给定主题关联较弱；匹配到检索增强与对齐，但摘要未涉及计算方法或知识对齐。
summary.caveat: 基于特定地区与季节的野外观察，摘要未给出样本量和统计效应大小；对计算或知识图谱研究参考价值有限。

papers.title: Generalists link peaks in the shifting adaptive landscape of Australia's dragon lizards
papers.abstract: The adaptive landscape is a flexible concept in biology which helps map entities onto an eco-evolutionary topography. A common practice is clustering species to identify adaptive peaks but the pathways that allow movement into new adaptive zones remain poorly understood. Here we integrate new sequence-capture (>5,000 nuclear markers) and multivariate morphological data to investigate the adaptive landscape of Amphibolurinae dragon lizards (Agamidae). Our well-supported, time-calibrated phylogeny includes over 175 species, including iconic taxa such as the frilled-neck lizard, thorny devil, and bearded dragon. We show that arrival in Australia was followed by rapid expansion of morphological diversity facilitated by generalist habitat use. Ancestral dragons likely had broad niche breadths and intermediate morphologies that provided avenues to subsequent specialization. These findings reveal an evolutionary pathway for adaptive diversification in a major continental radiation.

summary.takeaway: 该研究整合序列捕获与形态学数据，构建了澳洲龙蜥（Amphibolurinae）超过175种的时间校准系统发育树，提出祖先类群借助广生态位与中间形态进入澳洲后快速扩张形态多样性，为后续特化提供通路。
summary.methods: 使用新的序列捕获数据（>5,000个核标记）与多变量形态学数据，构建时间校准系统发育树，并进行祖先生态位与形态分析。
summary.relevance: 摘要涉及系统发育与性状演化，但未涉及检索增强、对齐、GRN或预训练模型，与给定主题的关联在摘要层面不明确。
summary.caveat: 摘要未报告具体统计支持值、模型比较或因果检验，仅给出定性演化叙述；与计算主题的关联需进一步核实。

papers.title: Averaging in gene perturbation benchmarks hides perturbation-strength variation: Consequences for model evaluation
papers.abstract: Perturbation-response benchmarks usually represent each genetic intervention by averaging all cells assigned that perturbation label. We inquire what perturbation-strength information is lost by this averaging, and whether current model predictions preserve enough perturbation-specific information for this perturbation-strength variation to be evaluated. Using X-Atlas/Orion CRISPRi screens, we use depth-corrected guide abundance as a cell-level proxy for perturbation strength and examine how transcriptional responses vary within a nominal perturbation. Higher perturbation strength is associated with greater response reproducibility. The effect is present in two human cell lines, HCT116 and HEK293T, but is larger in HCT116. For model evaluation, HCT116 retrieval tests show that observed responses preserve perturbation identity, whereas the evaluated STATE and Cell2Sentence predictions do not reliably recover it, hence the question of within-perturbation strength information cannot be meaningfully evaluated.

summary.takeaway: 基因扰动基准通常按扰动标签对细胞取平均，研究指出这会丢失扰动强度信息，且所评估的STATE与Cell2Sentence预测无法可靠保留扰动身份，导致扰动内强度信息难以有效评估。
summary.methods: 基于X-Atlas/Orion CRISPRi筛选，以深度校正的guide丰度作为细胞水平扰动强度代理，在HCT116和HEK293T两个人类细胞系中分析转录响应变异，并开展HCT116检索测试评估模型。
summary.relevance: 直接涉及扰动响应数据的表示、检索与模型评估中的对齐问题，与检索增强与对齐主题相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明样本量、效应大小或除检索测试外的评估指标；结论主要基于两个细胞系，泛化性有限。

papers.title: OCTRON - a general purpose segmentation and tracking pipeline for behavioral experiments
papers.abstract: Quantifying animal behavior across species with complex, deformable body plans requires capturing full-body shape rather than sparse skeletal keypoints. Yet accessible, end-to-end tools that take researchers from mask annotation through model training to reliable multi-object tracking are lacking. Here we present OCTRON, a fully trainable pipeline for multi-object segmentation, detection, and tracking that is broadly applicable across experimental setups and organisms. OCTRON leverages large segmentation foundation models to rapidly generate experimenter-supervised annotations from minimal input, overcoming the manual labeling bottleneck of supervised segmentation. These annotations train compact, task-specific models: segmentation networks for extracting pixel-level information such as shape and appearance, or lightweight detection networks for fast centroid tracking. Coupled with multi-object trackers and an interactive track-curation interface in napari, OCTRON enables complete behavioral quantification with minimal manual intervention. We validate OCTRON across species from transparent marine annelids to camouflaging cuttlefish, and in multi-species behavioral assays.

summary.takeaway: OCTRON提供从掩码标注、模型训练到多目标跟踪的端到端可训练流水线，利用分割基础模型减少人工标注，支持全身体形行为量化。
summary.methods: 借助大型分割基础模型由少量输入生成实验者监督标注，训练紧凑的分割网络或轻量检测网络，结合多目标跟踪器与napari交互式轨迹整理界面；在透明海洋环节动物、伪装乌贼及多物种行为实验中验证。
summary.relevance: 涉及基础模型预训练与下游适配，与预训练主题相关；分割基础模型生成标注也涉及数据对齐问题。
summary.caveat: 摘要未提供量化性能指标、与基线方法的系统比较或失败案例分析；验证物种范围虽广但具体评估标准不明。

papers.title: Spatiotemporally resolved single-nucleus transcriptomics reveals cellular and regional vulnerability in the midbrain in Parkinson's disease.
papers.abstract: Parkinson's disease (PD) is clinically and biologically heterogeneous, and ethnic differences may influence its pathogenesis. However, single-nucleus transcriptomic data from East Asian populations remain limited. Here, we present a spatially resolved single-nucleus transcriptomic atlas of the human substantia nigra (SN) across the PD continuum, control, incidental Lewy body disease (iLBD), and advanced PD, in pathologically confirmed Korean individuals. Our integrative analysis revealed early α-synuclein aggregation in the ventrolateral SN, subtype-selective vulnerability of dopaminergic neurons, and relative preservation of the dorsomedial SN and ventral tegmental area. Trajectory and gene regulatory network analyses of astrocytes and microglia revealed spatiotemporally distinct, disease-associated glial responses, each driven by divergent molecular programs. We also identified two transcriptionally distinct vascular spatial clusters that exhibited differential vulnerability and remodeling. Spatial ligand-receptor analysis of α-synuclein-positive regions revealed intercellular signaling events associated with early pathology, including extracellular matrix remodeling and synaptic adhesion, which were prominent in the iLBD but largely diminished in advanced PD. Integration with PD genome-wide association studies using MAGMA demonstrated differential coupling between genetic risk, spatially resolved cell-state programs, and pseudotime-inferred microglial dynamics across ancestries. This study provides the first high-resolution, spatially mapped single-nucleus transcriptomic resource from an East Asian PD cohort, illuminating early perturbations in the midbrain intercellular and microenvironment that may underlie selective dopaminergic vulnerability and guide the development of ancestry-informed therapeutic strategies.

summary.takeaway: 研究构建了东亚人群帕金森病连续谱（对照、iLBD、晚期PD）的黑质空间分辨单核转录组图谱，揭示腹外侧黑质早期α-突触核蛋白聚集、多巴胺能神经元亚型选择性易损及胶质与血管细胞的空间差异响应。
summary.methods: 对病理确诊的韩国个体黑质组织进行空间分辨单核转录组测序，开展轨迹与基因调控网络分析、空间配体-受体分析，并用MAGMA整合PD GWAS。
summary.relevance: 包含星形胶质细胞与微胶质细胞的基因调控网络分析，与GRN/Regulon主题相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明样本量与统计功效；跨祖先比较的结论需更多队列验证；部分发现为关联性推断。

papers.title: Recurrent leukaemia stem cell states define the antigenic landscape of paediatric Acute Myeloid Leukaemia
papers.abstract: Paediatric acute myeloid leukaemia (pAML) remains a leading cause of childhood cancer mortality, with disease heterogeneity representing a major obstacle to effective immunotherapy. To enable rational immunotherapy design accounting for such heterogeneity, we combined single-cell transcriptomics and surface proteomics (CITE-seq). Using an integrated framework for malignant cell identification and unbiased gene program identification, we resolved three conserved leukaemia stem cell (LSC) subtypes, primitive (P-LSC), monocytic (M-LSC), and erythroid-like (E-LSC), that frequently coexist within individual patients in varying proportions and represent distinct stem-cell states with characteristic immunophenotypes and transcriptional programmes. Quantitative surface antigen profiling revealed that no single target achieved full LSC coverage. CLEC12A, an antigen currently being evaluated clinically, was expressed across P-LSC and M-LSC but was largely absent from E-LSC. In contrast, CD84 provided complementary coverage in the P and M groups and served as the primary target in the E-LSC population. The combination of CLEC12A and CD84 provided broad coverage across all three LSC subtypes, while sparing healthy haematopoietic stem cells. Validation across independent single-cell and bulk cohorts confirmed the robustness of this combination. These findings establish a paediatric-specific framework for antigen prioritisation in AML, identify CLEC12A/CD84 as a robust dual-targeting strategy across heterogeneous LSC states, and provide a blueprint for the rational design of next-generation CAR T-cell combinations.

papers.title: Phylogenomics, Spatiotemporal Transcriptional Dynamics and Cis-Regulatory Architecture Underlying the Portulaca oleracea Antioxidant Network Under Extreme Salinity.
papers.abstract: Global soil salinization severely threatens agricultural productivity. Portulaca oleracea L., an extreme xerohalophyte, displays exceptional salinity tolerance, yet the transcriptional architecture coordinating its antioxidant defenses across organs and developmental stages remains unresolved. In this study, multi-tissue high-throughput RNA-Seq, quantitative real-time PCR (qRT-PCR) validation, comparative phylogenomics across 154 plant genomes, and condition-specific gene regulatory network (GRN) modeling were integrated to characterize 436 antioxidant loci in P. oleracea. Under chronic hypersalinity (12 d), mature plants exhibited marked regulatory asymmetry: roots mounted a multi-tiered frontline defense driven by Fe/Mn-SOD (SOD2), cytosolic glutaredoxin 3 (50.24-fold induction), and class III peroxidases (PRX), whereas leaves suppressed multiple baseline peroxidase transcripts while selectively upregulating a putative secretory PRX (110.24-fold induction). Comparing developmental stages and stress durations revealed that juvenile leaves mounted a pronounced activation of glutathione-dependent pathways (GPX/GR) during acute osmotic stress, whereas adult foliage subjected to chronic salinity displayed a streamlined network consistent with catalase (CAT) post-transcriptional stabilization hypotheses and an upregulated glycine, serine, and threonine metabolic axis. GRN modeling predicted seven stress-specific candidate hub transcription factors (spanning the B3, LBD, C3H, AP2/ERF, and bHLH families), and promoter motif analysis identified a proximal GCC-rich element within salt-inducible CAT paralogs corresponding to putative AP2/ERF-binding sites. Together, these findings elucidate the organ-specific division of labor and cis-regulatory landscape underlying halotolerance in P. oleracea, providing prioritized candidate targets for engineering climate-resilient crops.
papers.venue: Plant science : an international journal of experimental plant biology

summary.takeaway: 研究整合多组织转录组、比较系统发育基因组学与条件特异GRN建模，刻画马齿苋在极端盐胁迫下抗氧化网络的器官特异分工及顺式调控架构，并预测候选枢纽转录因子。
summary.methods: 多组织高通量RNA-Seq与qRT-PCR验证，跨154个植物基因组的比较系统发育基因组学，条件特异基因调控网络建模及启动子基序分析。
summary.relevance: 核心涉及条件特异GRN建模与顺式调控分析，与GRN/Regulon主题直接相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明重复数、GRN预测的验证程度；枢纽转录因子与基序结合仅为计算预测，缺乏实验验证；部分结论基于相关性推断。
